capsule_preflight.decision: The missing domains were resident and MEMORY.BIN static ownership, not frame-boundary behavior. No live replay was justified.

table_static_frontier.extent: 64 rows x 5 native berry columns = 320 bytes
table_static_frontier.overlay_scope: All REBUILD/files .BIN images scanned by the transient C census
writer_classes: mover_init_from_record: clamp values below 64 up to 64 for the applicable actor class
actor_player_contact_resolver: two -2 lanes guarded at 65, one +2 lane guarded below 200
type_0x3f_construct_contact_action_dispatch and contact_walker: lazy 64-row old-column to new-column copy
contact_vs_actor_handler damage tail: -2 lane guarded at 33
table_static_frontier.correction: The old artifact's 'unlocated increment source' is resolved at 0x8004B4F4. The old 'frontend 0xFF scan' is not frontend code; it is gameplay-side lazy berry-column inheritance at 0x80054644..0x8005469C, mirrored by the contact walker at 0x80058A74..0x80058AB4.

adaptive_encounter_law.positive_direction: 0x8004B4A0 calls ordinary contact damage. 0x8004B4A8 rereads true health 0x800A6594; only when it changed does 0x8004B4F4 add 2 to table[actor_id*5 + berry], while the old value is below 200.
adaptive_encounter_law.negative_direction: Flik-to-actor hit/KO paths subtract 2 under lane-specific floor guards.
adaptive_encounter_law.spawn_direction: mover_init_from_record clears actor flag bit 0x2 when the score is at least 100 and actor id is not 15.
adaptive_encounter_law.chase_binding: SYS_enemy_ai independently establishes actor flag bit 0x2 as the CHASE gate. The landed-hit path sets it when the score is below 120, actor metadata byte +0x11 is 100, and actor id is neither 13 nor 15.
adaptive_encounter_law.grasshopper_boundary: Actor id 15 is explicitly exempt from both the spawn clear and landed-hit set paths. The design reason is not encoded in the resident branch and remains a low-return semantic residual.
adaptive_encounter_law.naming_boundary: The bytes are persistent per-species/per-berry adaptive encounter scores. Calling the entire table HP is false; some consumers use thresholds to drive CHASE or reaction flags.

save_schema_closure.layout: 348 state bytes: lives, campaign progress, 19-byte unlock/ending block, a serializer gap at 21..27, and the 320-byte adaptive table at 28..347.
save_schema_closure.byte_0x8009B88A: Resolved by E15 as a persisted alternate-FMV sequence counter. The resident call at 0x8004FFD4 increments it and requests movie id 41 plus the incremented byte. Exact unusual-save wrap behavior remains E15's bounded residual.
save_schema_closure.continue: C16's Interpreter evidence establishes that Continue restores lives through scene_config_apply at 0x80055538, not through direct new-game initialization.
save_schema_closure.results_save_chain: The one 0x800823E4 reader in MEMORY.BIN gates serialize_savegame_buffer -> memcard_load_dispatch/card writer -> scene_config_apply, then clears the flag.

options_static_frontier.input_contract: Fixed literal pad masks are read from held 0x80082412 and edge 0x800822E4. No mutable control-remap table participates in this path.
options_static_frontier.rumble: The option branch at 0x800B73B0 tests/sets/clears bit 0x80 and calls pad_rumble_update at 0x800B74E4.
options_static_frontier.screen_position: The branch beginning at 0x800B75B8 handles d-pad adjustment and stores 0x800822CC/0x800822D0. The same function passes those globals to set_draw_env_offset at 0x800B6B58.
options_static_frontier.audio: The function reapplies the paired-table CD mix through cd_audio_volume_apply at 0x800B7900. It has zero direct accesses to the SFX master-volume scalar 0x8008247E.
options_static_frontier.persistence: The 348-byte memcard serializer contains none of the option globals. These option effects are runtime/frontend state, not fields in the E14 save payload.
options_static_frontier.control_remap_verdict: No retail control-remapping mechanism was found. The previous row wording bundled an unsupported remap assumption into the real options question.

movie_policy.if_reopened: Record a normal-speed Interpreter movie through Options and Save/Load only for a named presentation or card-I/O question. A modified save/disc oracle requires a pristine-base build and cold boot.
